items.title: Crimson Desert studio Pearl Abyss is implementing AI "throughout our entire development pipeline", expects DokeV in 2028
items.excerpt: Pearl Abyss says it is integrating AI across its whole development pipeline to raise productivity and quality, including on the creature-collecting action game DokeV, now targeted for 2028 - months after gen-AI assets were pulled from Crimson Desert.

items.title: Despite Crimson Desert's AI backlash, Pearl Abyss is now implementing the tech "throughout our entire development pipeline"
items.excerpt: GamesRadar's take on Pearl Abyss's pipeline-wide AI adoption, noting gen-AI assets were removed from Crimson Desert in March after player backlash. (Same story as Eurogamer - alternate source.)

items.title: 『紅の砂漠』のPearl Abyss、AI活用を拡大へ―反復作業の自動化やテストの最適化
items.excerpt: Japanese coverage detailing Pearl Abyss's AI plan: automating repetitive production work and optimising testing, applied to DokeV, with a development-progress update promised within 2026. (Same story - alternate source with workflow detail.)

items.title: Quick Spectral Super Resolution comes soon to six PS5 games: Spider-Man 2, CONTROL Resonant, The Finals, ARC Raiders, No Man's Sky, and Helldivers
items.excerpt: Sony's QSSR, a lighter ML upscaler that brings part of the PS5 Pro's PSSR to the base PS5, is rolling out to six more games - a Sony-shipped AI rendering release rather than a mod.

items.title: Sony's base PS5 AI upscaling tech is making that $900 PS5 Pro price look worse
items.excerpt: Remedy's senior graphics programmer calls QSSR 'the same kind of leap on the PS5 that PSSR brought to PS5 Pro' as Spider-Man 2, No Man's Sky and others get AI-upscaled visual updates. (Same story as Wccftech.)

items.title: Spider-Man 2 and more are going to look even better on base PS5
items.excerpt: AI upscaling on base PS5 expands beyond Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei as QSSR support comes to a new batch of titles. (Same story - alternate source.)

items.title: PS5 QSSR comes to Control Resonant, Marvel's Spider-Man 2, ARC Raiders, and more
items.excerpt: QSSR, released last month, gives base PS5 owners some of the benefits of PS5 Pro-exclusive PSSR; the new title list was announced on 11-13. (Same story - alternate source.)

items.title: Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney predicts AI revolution in gaming with 10X productivity and entirely new genres
items.excerpt: In a GamesBeat exclusive, Sweeney says AI could deliver up to 10x productivity, revive experimentation and spawn new genres if developers embrace it - and outlines how Epic sees AI reshaping how games are built. (Commentary - check for concrete Epic tool/policy news in body.)

items.title: How to protect your IP against the army of AI clones
items.excerpt: Pryor Cashman lawyers give practical steps for developers to protect their games under US law when generative AI tools are used to clone them.

items.title: "It's a wild situation" - An investor and publisher perspective on the rise of AI copycats, the discoverability crisis, and more
items.excerpt: A panel at the AI and Games Conference in London weighs the problems and opportunities AI brings, from AI-made copycat games to store discoverability.

items.title: Steam's submission and approval backlog is forcing indie devs to delay game launches
items.excerpt: Valve says it has spent 'the last several weeks' scaling its review process as a flood of submissions, widely tied to AI-made games, pushes indie launches back.

items.title: Why are games hiding their blatant AI usage if they think it's totally cool and fine and the future
items.excerpt: Aftermath examines how studios skirt Steam's AI disclosure rules and why games using generative AI keep leaving it off their store pages.

items.title: As low-effort AI slop continues to flood Steam, yet more developers announce game delays caused by Valve's growing approval backlog
items.excerpt: More indie developers are pushing back release dates as Steam's review queue grows amid a surge of low-effort AI-generated submissions.

items.title: 「Steam審査が終わらない」多数のゲームで発売延期続出。待っている間にAIクローン発生
items.excerpt: Steam review delays caused by surging submissions and frequent re-reviews are forcing release delays - and AI clones of games can appear while developers wait. (Same story as Eurogamer/GI.biz - Japanese source.)

items.title: 対話型AI「Claude」が『ポケモン』関連の作業を拒否するようになったとの報告
items.excerpt: Users report Claude now refuses Pokemon-related work - not only game imitation but also using the series' assets and logos - extending Anthropic's clone restrictions to fan projects.

items.title: "Claude models are starting to refuse work on Pokemon fan projects," says vibe coder spending up to $2,000 a month
items.excerpt: The developer of Pokemon Arena 2D says Claude has begun refusing work on the fan game after Anthropic's crackdown, but the project will continue. (Same story as AUTOMATON.)

items.title: Xbox boss seemingly champions gen-AI development as she celebrates 25 years of Xbox
items.excerpt: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's 25th-anniversary memo says a small team will soon build worlds that today take hundreds, read widely as an endorsement of generative AI in game making.

items.title: Xbox CEO looks to the future as Microsoft's console turns 25: 'A single person will soon be able to wield capabilities that once required entire nations'
items.excerpt: PC Gamer reads Sharma's anniversary message as an AI vision for Xbox development. (Same story as Eurogamer.)

items.title: Xbox CEO hints that the solution to an imploding video game industry is AI
items.excerpt: Kotaku on the same Sharma memo, framing it against layoffs and industry contraction. (Same story - alternate source.)

items.title: One Elder Scrolls fan is reviving and upgrading (with AI) a lost spin-off for the Nokia N-Gage and porting it to PC
items.excerpt: A fan is using AI tools to restore and upgrade The Elder Scrolls Travels: Shadowkey, the N-Gage spin-off, and port it to PC.

items.title: 조카 그림, 클로드 페이블 5.2가 갓게임으로 제작
items.excerpt: Developer Lex Toumbourou handed his nephew's hand-drawn game design to Claude Fable 5.2 and got a 12-stage, 18-character four-player co-op beat-'em-up, 'Aiden's Revenge', playable in a browser overnight. (AI-coded game demo - deprioritized category.)

items.title: DLSS 5 now available in War Thunder
items.excerpt: War Thunder ships official DLSS 5 with 3D-guided neural rendering on RTX 50 Series, letting developers tune AI-generated lighting and materials. (Upscaling cap - official NVIDIA integration.)

items.title: 최석원 컴투스플랫폼 대표 "'하이브 액실'로 글로벌 공략, 백엔드 연동 AI로 처리"
items.excerpt: Com2uS Platform says its game backend Hive Axel is built so AI agents can read it and wire up login, payments and other backend integration with almost no human intervention; Unreal, Godot and HTML5 support follows in early 2027.

items.title: Following site-wide discussion on AI use, Nexus Mods add a "daily limit" to spots in the new mods tab
items.excerpt: After its AI-disclosure debate, Nexus Mods caps how many new-mods-tab spots one uploader can take with rapid-fire uploads in 24 hours. (Follow-up to the 11-05 Nexus AI disclosure story.)
